test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Somebody sent me a gift on my anniversary.

options.text: I was surprised to have been sent a gift on my anniversary.
Someone sent a gift on my anniversary.
I was sent a gift on my anniversary by someone.
I would be sent a gift on my anniversary by someone.

solution:
The correct answer is** "I was sent a gift on my anniversary by someone."**
